$comment: Splunk MCP server registration for the Shareworks defect-hunter plugin. Copy the 'servers' block into .vscode/mcp.json for VS Code, or configure via repository Settings > Copilot > Coding agent > MCP configuration for the Copilot coding agent. Choose ONE of the two server options below.

splunk-mcp.$comment: OPTION A - Official Splunk MCP Server (Splunkbase app 7931), runs inside Splunk Cloud/Enterprise 9.4+. Replace host with your Splunk MCP endpoint.

splunk-mcp-selfhosted.$comment: OPTION B - splunk/splunk-mcp-server2 (self-hosted, includes SPL input validation guardrails and output sanitization). Recommended if logs may contain PII. Rename to 'splunk-mcp' if used, and remove Option A.

inputs.description: Bearer token for the Splunk MCP endpoint (READ-ONLY service account, scoped to Shareworks indexes only)
Splunk auth token for the read-only service account (search-only capabilities, Shareworks indexes only)

$security_requirements: Service account role: search-only. Explicitly deny: schedule_search on other apps, edit_* capabilities, |delete, |collect, |outputlookup.
Index scoping: srchIndexesAllowed limited to the Shareworks app/batch/web indexes.
Search quotas: set srchDiskQuota and srchJobsQuota low for this account to bound agent cost.
Rotate the token on your standard secret-rotation schedule; store as a repo/organization secret, never in files.
